title: Special String
description: Recognises NXT-prefixed strings whose numeric suffix is even or divisible by 7.

data.question: Write a program that reads a string. Print "Special String" when it starts with NXT and the remaining digits form a number that is even or divisible by 7, otherwise print "Not a Special String".

brief.summary: Recognises NXT-prefixed strings whose numeric suffix is even or divisible by 7.

sections.body: Write a program that reads a string. Print "Special String" when it starts with NXT and the remaining digits form a number that is even or divisible by 7, otherwise print "Not a Special String".

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It checks the first three characters, then converts the rest of the string with int() and tests it against 2 and 7.
